messages:
Maya (Finance): Quick flag: vendor Nimbus Cloud invoiced EUR 4,200, but payment requested in USDC. Invoice shows VAT ID DE987654321 and a footer 'registered in Germany'. They marked 0% VAT. Do we treat as reverse-charge? Also vendor asks if we can gross-up for possible withholding.

Luca (Tax): If it's B2B and DE VAT ID is valid, reverse charge applies. Ask for VIES snapshot and the legal entity registration (HRB number). Crypto payment currency doesn't change tax treatment. For withholding: German-EU cross-border SaaS usually no withholding, but if payee claims nonresident status outside EU, ask for W-8/W-9 accordingly.

Priya (Accounts Payable): AP: hold payment until we get the registration docs. Also need to know which legal entity is being paid (German GmbH vs US subsidiary).

VendorBot: VIES check DE987654321 => invalid (no match).

Maya (Finance): Noted. I'll ask vendor to reissue with explicit legal name/HRB and VAT cert. Also asked for tax residency docs.

Luca (Tax): Good. If vendor insists on gross-up, escalate to Legal and update contract template.

Priya (Accounts Payable): Put payment on hold and flagged ticket AP-9987.

Maya (Finance): ETA from vendor 72h. Thanks.
